### Signature

Goodberry, Hunter's Mark, Archery fighting style (Longbow).

**Party-wide convention — Goodberry as standard revival.** Nyx prepares Goodberries every day and distributes them to teammates; they become the party's pooled stock of single-use revival items. A teammate dropped to 0 HP is fed one of Nyx's berries (any holder may do so as an action) and recovers to exactly 1 HP. **All recoveries-to-1-HP in this campaign use a Nyx Goodberry**; recoveries that bring a PC back above 1 HP are something else (Cure Wounds, healing potion, etc.). The transcript Spanish *baya* — frequently rendered by STT as *valla* — refers to these.
